note: CORRECTED: earlier 1.6 ms x86_64 max was a one-off warmup/OS-scheduling hiccup, not a tail-latency signal. Not included. Warmup excluded by running a fresh batch (200 samples) and taking percentiles over the steady-state workload.
p50_vs_p99_swap_attribution: Row medians (p50) and p95 are set by the FP Givens-rotation + manifold projection in the defense path: ~2x slower on Cortex-A76 than on x86_64 (0.0038 vs 0.0017 ms). Tails (p99/max) are set by warmup/OS noise: the dev box shows larger, noisier tails (max up to 0.34 ms in a cold run); the Pi is tighter and lower (max ~0.065 ms, stable). Hence the embedded platform is faster at the tail yet slower at the median — not an error.
